document_metadata.title: My K-Pop Secret
document_metadata.domain: entertainment fiction, K-pop culture, romance, identity
document_metadata.purpose: Tell the story of a barista who enters the world of K-pop idols through an unexpected confrontation and disguised audition, exploring themes of class, identity, and fame.

publication_context.cultural_context: Contemporary K-pop culture, NYC setting, fan culture dynamics, idol industry practices
publication_context.historical_significance: Explores modern K-pop industry, parasocial relationships, gender performance, and working-class precarity

contract_information.custom_terms: Semantic compression using AI-extracted narrative structures and thematic analysis. Original creative work. Compressed format preserves semantic fidelity while enabling efficient storage and regeneration.

global_context.core_thesis: A collision between working-class survival and celebrity privilege forces two protagonists from opposite worlds onto a convergent path, exploring identity, authenticity, and power in the K-pop industry.
primary_objectives: Establish dual-POV narrative following Hana (barista) and Jiho (idol leader) from antagonism to convergence.
Explore class dynamics through service work versus celebrity privilege.
Navigate gender gatekeeping via cross-presentation and disguise.
Examine authenticity versus persona in the idol industry.
Build toward VMAs performance as narrative climax.
key_themes: Power and control in entertainment industry

narrative_arc.progression: Café confrontation → viral fallout → disguised audition → recognition and stakes escalation
narrative_arc.resolution_trajectory: Unresolved tension propelling toward next arc (VMAs finale)
